primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-coherent-tangent-space (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 1429-1440

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: (RS*) makes the fibres deformation categories; base change identifies the fibre over k with the 2-fibre product, reducing to B = Spec(k); over k, the thickening Spec(k) -> Spec(k[epsilon]) and the coherent-over-thickening lemma identify the tangent space with lifts of G_0 to a flat module on X_epsilon, which the deformation theory lemma computes as Ext^1_{O_{X_0}}(G_0, G_0), with Inf = Ext^0; G_0 is coherent on the Noetherian X_0 (finite presentation over a field), so both Exts are finite dimensional (source lines 1442-1502)
